{{Top|leg}}
'''Blue Watch''' was the codename for the unit formed by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]] of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] and [[Darman Skirata|Darman]] of [[Omega Squad]]. The pairing was decided by [[Kal Skirata]] during an unauthorized [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|mission]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] terrorist ring.<ref name="TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>
